<thought>The proton NMR data shows four distinct signals (at 2.93 ppm, 4.43 ppm, 5.04 ppm, and 6.05 ppm). Each signal corresponds to a unique hydrogen environment, regardless of how many protons contribute to that signal. Therefore, the compound has four chemically equivalent hydrogen types.</thought>
<final_answer>4</final_answer>
